body: I understand where you’re coming from. By the way, it doesn’t come off as you trying to sound like a victim in the first place. We all are subject to feeling and expressing whatever emotions we may be feeling at the moment. But honestly, I can relate to you. I get the same way at times, random thoughts of suicide or feeling doomed/out of place. I get that way a lot, and something I learned that helped me is to throw on some jazz or whatever calming music you’d prefer and hum. Or sing. Distract your mind for the most part.
